<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.45.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Breaking Changes 🛠
* [fix] Slugify Markdown anchors by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10925
### New Features 🎉
* Add url to st.context by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10665
* Add `icon` to `st.text_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10761
* Add `icon` to `st.number_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10711
* [theming] Unify `st.help` border colors by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10916
* Allow adding new options to selectbox / multiselect dynamically by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10788
* [theming] Use dark mix for hovered color instead of `theme.colors.secondaryBg` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10930
* [theming] Fine tune element spacing for `baseRadius` config by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10915
* Don't disable element when empty options but accept_new_options is true by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10958
* Optimize `st.write` usage with single string arg by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10985
* Add `ip_address` to `st.context` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10651
* Add `is_embedded` to st.context by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11055
* [feat] Add tab_index to iframe and custom component by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11065
* [AdvancedLayouts] New width parameter is added to alerts and exception. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11142
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* Fix `tabs` and `link_button` from getting disabled on disconnect by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10861
* [Fix] Being unable to determine the form a current element is in by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10752
* Remove rainbow from badge color literal by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10896
* Preserve selectbox frontend state when clicking away and don't rerun until selecting option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10891
* Fix `showErrorDetails` showing wrong value in `streamlit config show` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10921
* [RFC] fix chat input height for multi-line placeholder by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10931
* [theming] use `borderColor` in `theme.sidebar` for sidebar border by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10944
* Only show links to google/ChatGPT if the site is localhost by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10971
* Add marker that icon is an emoji for set page config by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10912
* [Fix] Disable sidebar page nav links when app not connected by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10946
* [fix] st.html resize handling by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10976
* Exclude dot files and __init__.py from pages by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11009
* [Fix]: Button hover color overwrites colored text by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10996
* [theming] Fix radio button visual for different `baseFontSize` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10990
* Allow auto-reload of config on exceptions by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10857
* [fix] st.fragment interaction with st.{balloons,snow} by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11015
* [Fix] FE validation for `st.date_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10764
* [fix] Better support for SVGs with only viewBox defined by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11038
* [Fix] Refactor `st.html` for style tags by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10979
* [fix] Sidebar sizing issue under certain conditions by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10733
* Fix encoding by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11090
* BugFix 11097: Update FontFaceDeclaration to support customizable font styles by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11098
* Fix: Handle Multi-Part Extensions Like .tar.gz in File Upload Validation by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11043
* BugFix 11062: Sidebar resizing by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11063
* Preserve context_info fields on rerun triggered by `st.rerun` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11113
* BugFix 11064: st.dataframe({}) shouldn't show errors by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11100
* Support emoji favicons through navigation by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11154
### Other Changes
* Update placeholder style and in-edit input margin for Selectbox and Multiselect by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10865
* Release/1.44.0 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10908
* Keep SessionInfo active after initialization, but include connection information by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9886
* Release/1.44.1 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10977
* [theming] use markdown text colors for primitives by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11033
* [theming] replace danger and success colors in non-notif components by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11034
* [docs] correct toast position by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11056
* Remove st.experimental_audio_input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11105
* Deexperimentalization of st.user by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11095
* [Fix] `st.audio_input` actions styling by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11118
* [Fix] `st.camera_input` disabled button styling by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11116
* [chore] Update caniuse-lite by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11134
* [chore] Add `[USER]/no-explicit-any` lint rule by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11133
* [Fix] Element toolbar papercuts by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11135
* [Fix] Element toolbar update - v2 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11155
* Clarify file creation instruction in Quickstart section of README.md by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11089
* Remove anchor along with query params from the url  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11171

* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11043
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11089
